The grant runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023 and is handled by the Facilities Planning and Management division.

output.headline: Allows Board and district bodies to meet virtually in October 2022
output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2223-0028B, which makes the findings needed under California's open-meetings law (the Brown Act) so district legislative bodies can hold virtual meetings in October 2022. No dollar amount is involved.

output.headline: Pays a consultant up to $50,000 to study new teacher credentialing programs and support new teachers
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract with a consultant to analyze whether the district should start new teacher credentialing programs and to lead the application if it proceeds. The consultant will also help write state educator grant applications and organize 2-3 gatherings for new teachers. The contract runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.headline: Pays MCT Technology up to $23,117.40 for Carecloud software to run early learning programs
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for Carecloud software used by the Early Childhood Development Department for enrollment, eligibility, attendance, meal counts, licensing compliance and billing. It runs August 22, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $103,590.74 for a student support specialist at Fremont High
output.summary: The Board approves a contract for Bay Area Community Resources to hire and pay one Student Support Specialist at Fremont High School. The specialist offers tutoring, study skills and mentoring to pathway students and helps with work-based learning, field trips, internships and college outreach. It runs August 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $60,000 for a newcomer student safety program
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The stated service period is only about 12 days (August 15 to August 26, 2022) for a $60,000 program meant to raise attendance and graduation, which may be a misprinted date.
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for a student safety intervention and prevention program meant to raise attendance and graduation among newcomer students. It is handled by the Office of Equity. The stated period is August 15 through August 26, 2022.

output.headline: Pays Destiny Arts Center up to $10,000 for African Diasporic arts at Lockwood STEAM
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for over 700 hours of African Diasporic arts and culture for more than 500 students at Lockwood STEAM during the 2022-2023 school year. It is handled by the Community Schools and Student Services Department.

output.headline: Pays Elevo Learning up to $97,136 for elementary sports and social-emotional skills program
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for field games and sports such as basketball, Gaelic football, soccer and European handball. The aim is to help students practice and build social emotional learning (SEL) skills. It runs August 25, 2022 through May 31, 2023.

output.headline: Pays Brazen Technologies up to $14,497.70 for online recruiting chat software
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The title says Services Agreement 2022-2023 but the action text says Services Agreement 2021-2022.
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a subscription to Brazen's browser-based chat software, which runs online recruiting events and chats between employers and job seekers. The agreement runs April 1, 2022 through March 31, 2023, so it began before this approval.

output.headline: Awards G & G Builders $116,977 for new playground and court work at OAK at Howard
schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
output.summary: G & G Builders, Inc. of Livermore, the lowest responsive bidder, will tear out old basketball hoops, prepare the site for a multi-sport court, and install new playground tiles at Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School. The price is $116,977, including a $10,000 contingency allowance. Work is expected to run about 60 days starting September 29, 2022.

output.headline: Pays Public Profit up to $95,000 for data strategy help for community schools staff
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for ongoing data strategy work with the Community Schools Department and for building data skills among community school managers and other site leaders. It runs September 12, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

output.headline: Pays ACC Environmental Consultants up to $7,760.50 to test soil at Howard Elementary site
schools: Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School
output.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants of Oakland will sample and test soil for lead and arsenic, characterize soil waste, and write reports for the Oakland Academy of Knowledge at Howard Elementary School site improvements project. The cost is capped at $7,760.50, including up to $705.50 for additional services. Work runs September 29 to December 29, 2022.

output.headline: Pays KidzToPros up to $76,024 for elementary sports, dance, robotics and coding programs
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract for sports (soccer, flag football, basketball, kickball), Hip-Hop Dance, Maker Space, Wonder Robotics and coding. The goal is to build students' mental and social skills, self-esteem and fitness. It runs September 1, 2022 through May 31, 2023.

output.headline: Cuts a Coliseum College Prep teacher salary line from $79,376.36 to $31,750.54
output.summary: At the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the board is approving a 2022-23 budget change for Coliseum College Preparatory Academy. It lowers the Teacher Salaries line from $79,376.36 to $31,750.54, reducing the position from a full-time to a 0.40 full-time equivalent.

output.headline: Moves $47,625.82 at Coliseum College Prep from teacher salaries to a teacher on special assignment
output.summary: At the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the board is approving a 2022-23 budget change for Coliseum College Preparatory Academy. It transfers $47,625.82 from Teacher Salaries to a Teacher on Special Assignment line, which then totals $47,625.82. The text describes a transfer within the school's plan, not new spending.

output.headline: Moves $16,000 at Skyline High from three budget lines to teacher stipends
output.summary: At the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the board is approving a 2022-23 budget change for Skyline High School. It moves $16,000 from three lines (Conference Expenses $12,000, Transportation Costs $3,000, Teacher Salaries $1,000) into Teacher Salaries Stipends. The text describes a transfer, not new spending.

output.headline: Adds $32,486.36 to G & G Builders' East Oakland Pride playground project
output.summary: This change order adds asphalt patching and replacement of a concrete slab in the old kindergarten area to the East Oakland Pride Elementary School playmatting and structure project. It adds $32,486.36 and raises the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $596,516 to $629,002.36 with G & G Builders, Inc. of Livermore.

output.headline: Pays Yemeni students association up to $29,580 for Arabic and arts summer program
output.summary: The Board is approving, after the fact, a contract with the American Association of Yemeni Students and Professionals for Arabic classes, wellness activities and arts for the summer program, honoring Arab and Arab-American culture. The agreement ran June 1 through July 31, 2022, before this approval.

output.summary: The board is approving a data sharing agreement with Teaching Strategies, LLC of Bethesda, Maryland. It is added to the 2021-22 services agreement the board already approved with the same company. The agreement runs from October 2021 through June 2023 and has no fiscal impact.

output.headline: Partners with University of La Verne at no cost to place interns and practicum students in district schools
output.summary: The Board approves a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the University of La Verne for an intern partnership and practicum program covering teaching, counseling, school psychology, administrative and other credentials. output.summary: This changes an existing memorandum of understanding (MOU) with The Unity Council. It adds a role for Oakland Adult and Career Education on The Unity Council's Green Jobs Project team, which supports a California workforce grant and aims to build a training model other adult schools can copy. It also extends the agreement from June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2025, with no fiscal impact.

output.headline: Approves Personnel Report No. 2223-0002 from the Talent/Human Resources Department
output.summary: The Board approves a routine personnel report from the Talent/Human Resources Department. The official text lists no dollar amount or details of the individual personnel actions.

output.summary: The University of California, Berkeley's School of Social Welfare will place its Corps Youth Equity Fellows at district Early Childhood Education sites as volunteers on youth equity projects. They will work about 6 to 10 hours a week, for a total of 360 hours, from August 2022 through July 2024. The district pays nothing, and the work period began before this vote.

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $99,000.00

output.headline: Lets College Track use student data to support college success, at no cost
output.summary: The district will share student academic, financial and social-emotional data with College Track Oakland so it can tailor its programs and track trends. College Track must keep the data in a separate account, keep signed family releases under the federal student privacy law (FERPA), and may keep the data through college completion with the district's consent. The agreement runs August 2022 through July 2023 at no cost.

output.headline: Accepts up to $130,000 to fund a K-12 career pathway coordinator through Cabrillo college district
output.summary: The district will receive up to $130,000 in career technical education funding through the Cabrillo Community College District. The money supports a Strong Workforce Program K-12 Pathway Coordinator serving the Peralta Community College District area and its K-12 districts. OUSD will be the coordinator's employer and supervise the position from July 2022 through September 2023.

output.headline: Endorses Measure S, a city charter change on noncitizen voting in school board elections
output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2122-0029, which endorses Measure S on the November 8, 2022 Oakland ballot. Measure S would amend the city charter on noncitizen voting in Oakland Board of Education elections. No dollar amount is involved.

output.headline: Names who may sign for district funds and accounts as of September 29, 2022
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution listing the people verified as authorized signatories for named district funds and accounts. The list is effective as of September 29, 2022. No dollar amount is stated.

output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2223-0153, acting on a recommendation from the Measure G1 oversight commission. It approves the amended 2022-23 grant application and education spending plan for district middle schools. The text states no dollar amount.

output.headline: Pays HeyTutor up to $800,000 for small-group tutoring at 16 elementary schools

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $800,000.00

Tutors work with small groups for half of each school day, using the district's reading intervention curricula. The contract runs August 2022 through June 2023 and is capped at $800,000.

Piedmont will pay OUSD $69,810 for this, for August 2022 through July 2023. The work period began before this vote.

output.headline: Redefines the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee's terms and names new members
output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2223-0154 for the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee. It redefines an existing fixed term one time and names some members to open seats. No dollar amount is involved.
